description: Section 202A regeneration chains. Each chain generates a FRESH trip from `base_case_id` (itinerary_qa_cases.json) on the backend whose flags match `mode`, then applies the steps in order (a realistic v1 -> v2 -> v3 sequence). Templates like {d2s1} resolve, at run time, to the name of day 2 / stop 1 in the CURRENT itinerary. `expect.type` selects the objective check in run_regeneration_qa.py; the check restates the user's request, it never grades quality.

modes.as_configured: developer's normal .env: targeted regeneration off, legacy keyword-classified regeneration
